discovery_source: AusTraits v7.0.0; 249 family×trait systems / 42 families / 12 traits; original shared-OU+source noise inputs unchanged

discovery_evidence.scope: Hypothesis generation only. All five directional trait departures were selected after seeing the AusTraits output.

question: Do signed differences between empirical named-trait phylogenetic K ranks and independently source-calibrated homogeneous OU+observation models recur in a genuinely held-out primary observation source?
gate_order: Identify a new external primary observation collection or demonstrably nonoverlapping compilation without looking at K/target outcomes; never recycle original AusTraits measurements as independence.

Freeze trait semantics, measurement units and source crosswalk for the five named traits before accessing the target biological outcomes. Exclude incompatible dimensional definitions; no post-outcome semantic adjustment.

Verify provenance at primary DOI/dataset/measurement-ID level. Where coverage cannot establish independent primary observations, report source-overlap-limited transport rather than independent replication.

Before measuring new K, determine species-tip support, V.PhyloMaker2 scenario3/prune trees and K simulation informativeness; for a trait to count require at least 10 independent families with >=20 species, and at least 10 families with >=2 named traits for paired profile inference.
Recompute independent K and the matched observational heterogeneity model on source-native species sets; do not use discovery K values to set target error ratios or OU attraction.

Score the frozen five signed profile departures, aggregate two-sided and sign-oriented discrepancies with uncertainty clustered by family and source dataset, and compare to a source-conditioned homogeneous OU posterior-predictive distribution.
Report each tree axis and qualified/unqualified hypothesis separately. No new family or trait exclusions from observing target K.
Disclose any repeated primary source, low DOI ascertainment, incompatible trait semantics or tree uncertainty. If no source satisfies gates, mark untested and do not claim validation.

primary_new_source_decision.condition: At least four of five preread signed departures have qualified independent source support, preserve predicted directions on both S3 and prune trees, and a source-conditioned named-rank profile discrepancy is above its 97.5th simulated percentile on both tree axes.
primary_new_source_decision.caveats: Neither decision identifies selection or a trait-specific OU parameter; model family remains finite and comparisons depend on the source sampling graph.

no_reopening: The completed BIEN 201-system rho study has an explicit analysis-stop rule; no new primary hypothesis mining on those observed effects or retrospective reclassification of BIEN/AusTraits rho predictions is permitted.
analysis_window: No new-source trait values or K outcomes have been observed for this protocol. The discovery source is not an independent validation cohort.
